{{Quote|I am a member of the Imperial Medical Corps. Designation TL-30. [...] I was tasked with tending to Lord Malgus, after the battle of the Meridian Complex. Though his wounds were severe, he escaped our medical facility. I was his hostage. But he could not have survived on his own. '''TL-30''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who tended to [[Darth Malgus]]'s injuries following the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
TL-30 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion.

In the Imperial storyline, [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Darth Krovos]], and [[Darth Rivix]] met TL-30 when they defeated a gargantuan [[Graul/Legends|graul]] on their way to investigate the whereabouts of Darth Malgus in the [[Cave/Legends|caves]] of the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]]. TL-30 explained that Malgus held the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] hostage and had the droid keep Malgus alive while he considered his next moves after going rogue. Malgus dumping TL-30 in the caves with the graul. In the end, the player has to option to dismantle the droid for its [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] related to Malgus or help repair the droid to let it escape on its own.<ref name="Secrets" />
